name: Hit Points
summary: At level 1, gain the maximum value of your class Hit Die + your Constitution modifier. At later levels, either roll the Hit Die or use the fixed value: d6 = 4, d8 = 5, d10 = 6, d12 = 7, then add your Constitution modifier. Species and class features may alter your maximum hit points.
